entities.summary: Souad Massi (b. 1972-08-23, Algiers) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Algiers and Algeria. Known in the fields of algeria, composers & musicians, africa.
